explication: UniWorld-Family is a collection of image/video generation and editing systems: OSP2.0 focuses on image-to-video, V1 combines visual understanding with image generation/editing, and V2 fine-tunes image-editing models with reward feedback. The principal OSP2.0 path is image/prompt input through conditioning and video generation to saved output; the repository also includes training and benchmark evaluation. V1 and V2 are distinct product branches. Connections for unsampled subsystems are limited to README-documented capabilities or indexed references.
